abstraction_design.rationale: The shared pieces (cardsFor, Section, MoveTable, api client) are well shaped, but there is no reusable detail-page pattern and card variation is handled by boolean flags plus three separate construction paths — an Items section reuses helpers but copies page markup.

findings.issue: One data module holds the load logic for all six pages plus all API type shapes; every new/removed feature edits this file, and it will keep growing.
findings.suggestion: Split per domain (home.ts, pokemon.ts, moves.ts, types.ts, team.ts) over the shared api.ts and a small shared.ts for indexes/helpers like getSpecies/getTypes/cardsFor.

findings.issue: Species/default-variety/sprite resolution is implemented three ways: cardsFor resolves by pokemon-ref ID, getPokemonPage and getTeamPage by varieties lookup; a change to that rule must be applied in up to three places.
findings.suggestion: Extract a single speciesCard(speciesRefOrName) / defaultPokemon(species) helper used by all three sites.

findings.issue: Card.hidden exists solely for the ability page, so the generic card abstraction carries feature-specific meaning.
findings.suggestion: Render the 'Hidden ability' label in the ability page (e.g. via a per-item snippet or by keeping it out of Card) rather than as a card field.

findings.issue: showTypes boolean is threaded through CardList into PokemonCard — flag creep for the one real variation between card renderings.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is, but if a third variation appears, switch to per-card content (snippet prop) instead of adding more booleans.

findings.issue: Header columns (ALL_COLUMNS/columns) and the hand-written body cells are two parallel lists; adding a column means editing both plus the level-up special case.
findings.suggestion: Drive body cells from the same column descriptors (value renderers) so headers and cells stay in sync.

findings.issue: Uses setContext/getContext with a symbol key; Svelte ≥5.40 (current docs) recommends the type-safe createContext, and the skill guidance flags this.
findings.suggestion: Replace with createContext<TeamState>() returning the get/set pair.

findings.issue: Badge colors are derived by interpolating API type names into CSS custom property names (var(--type-{name})), silently falling back to muted if a name/token drifts.
findings.suggestion: Map type names to tokens explicitly (or centralize the mapping in one helper) so renames fail loudly.

findings.issue: Adding a new home filter touches the form, href(), update(), the server load's param parsing (app/src/routes/+page.server.ts:4-10) and getPokemonList's signature — five spots across three files.
findings.suggestion: Fine at current size; if filters grow, derive href() and parsing from one filter-definition list.

summary: A well-organized SvelteKit 3 app with an exemplary server/client seam: all data fetching sits behind a server-only client and pages receive plain view models, so data-source changes and most bug fixes land in one obvious place. Editability is held back by a single 445-line data module that every feature touches, three parallel card-construction paths, and small flag-creep (`showTypes`, `hidden`) in the otherwise clean component layer. Extending with a sibling resource (Items) reuses the helpers but copies the detail-page markup.
